title: Evaluating AI capabilities in detecting conspiracy theories on YouTube
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the models' ability to classify videos that discuss religious beliefs intertwined with conspiracy narratives, noting the difficulty in determining when religious claims cross into conspiracy territory.
findings: Videos discussing religious beliefs intertwined with conspiracy narratives were identified as among the most problematic cases for classification. The authors found it inherently subjective to determine when religious claims, often framed as doctrinal, cross into the territory of conspiracy theory, suggesting that a rigid binary classification is insufficient for such nuanced content.
